messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I'm going to do a small reorg of the rate/quota playbook links today. Aim is to collapse duplicate pages and add a single crosswalk table for metering -> dashboard panels. Will open a PR in an hour.
Maya Patel: thanks Alex. can you tag the exact pages? we'll need to update PRs that reference them.
Alex Chen: sure — affected pages: /docs/usage/tiers, /docs/metering/overview, /docs/dashboards/ratepanels, and the examples bundle.
Samira: quick note — the SDK snippets in /examples/sdk-headers.md reference header name `X-Redwood-Usage`. if you rename pages, update snippets and the import path.
Josh H: can you also add a short migration note for Dedicated customers? their dashboards still link to the old panel ids.
Alex Chen: yes. plan:
- create /docs/usage/playbook (new canonical)
- add crosswalk table mapping old URLs -> new anchors
- update SDK examples and snippets to use canonical link
- add a small migration checklist for Dedicated
Tiffany L: 1) for the crosswalk, can we include panel ids and grafana folder paths? 2) ping infra for redirects?
Alex Chen: yes to both. Infra redirect ticket will be in the PR description.
Samira: snippet patch idea — change header example to:
```
# python
headers = {"X-Redwood-Meter": "project:team:feature"}
resp = client.request(..., headers=headers)
```
Maya Patel: Also flag any internal links in /docs/metrics that use absolute prod URLs — we should convert them to relative so redirects keep working.
Alex Chen: good catch.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pulls/248 — title: "playbook: consolidate rate/quota links + crosswalk" (auto-detected reviewers: @maya @samira)
link-checker-bot: link-check started on branch playbook/links-reorg. Found 2 redirects missing: /dashboards/old-rate -> 404, /metering/legacy -> 404
Tiffany L: assigned infra ticket INF-912 for two redirects.
Josh H: can we add a short blurb in the Dedicated docs about how to remap panel IDs? I'll draft it and put a snippet for using our dashboard export/import tool.
Alex Chen: perfect. I'll stitch these changes into the PR and ping docs-reviewers tomorrow morning. If anyone wants to volunteer to review the SDK snippet edits today, ping me.
Maya Patel: I can do SDK snippet review after lunch.
Samira: I'll review the crosswalk table and grafana paths.
Alex Chen: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the thread with PR updates and the redirect ticket once INF-912 is linked.
